name: XCC_CB_RULE_FILTER_CONDITIONS_
description: This is the audit table for XCC_CB_RULE_FILTER_CONDITIONS which stores all the supplemental rule filters. These filters can be based on budget segments, COA segments that are not mapped to budget COA segments, Project segments and Project planning elements which are not mapped to budget COA segments and/or any transaction attributes.

columns.name: FILTER_CONDITION_CODE
columns.description: Either budget COA segment column name or GL COA segment column or project segment code specific to XCC or project planning element code specific to XCC or transaction attribute code specific to XCC

columns.name: FILTER_CONDITION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether this condition is associated with budget segment or GL COA or project segment or project planning element or transaction attribute

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: Tree that is used for specifying the segment values. This is relevant only when SEGMENT_VALUE rows are based on tree data

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version of the flexfield segment value. This is relevant only when SEGMENT_VALUE rows are based on tree data

columns.name: APPLICABLE_TO_ALL_VALUES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this control budget rule filter is applicable for all valus associated with this dimension or notr

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
